title: 2 bed/2 bath Condo - Less than 1 Mile to Broadway!
description:
This 2 bedroom, 2 bath condo is perfect for a girls weekend or a relaxing couples retreat! 

Start your mornings with coffee on the patio, where you’ll catch a beautiful view of the Nashville skyline. Then head out for the day knowing you’re just a short walk to all the energy of Broadway - Nissan Stadium, Bridgestone Arena, Ascend Amphitheater, and the historic Ryman Auditorium.

Enjoy in-laundry, free parking, and a fully stocked coffee station in this Germantown gem!
